definitions.explanation: Being so absorbed in an activity or emotion that one forgets oneself. Most commonly seen in the set phrase {無我夢中|むがむちゅう}.
The Buddhist doctrine that there is no permanent, independent self — one of the three marks of existence. Used in Buddhist and philosophical contexts.

examples.japanese: {無我|むが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境地|きょうち}→境地：12121_kyouchi⟧。
⟦{無我夢中|むがむちゅう}→無我夢中：05661_mugamuchuu⟧で⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I ran in a self-forgetful frenzy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無我|むが}になって⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: While performing, I lost myself and forgot the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無我|むが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧。
{釈迦|しゃか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無我|むが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説|と}いた→説く：14245_toku⟧。
examples.english: Shakyamuni taught the doctrine of no-self.

examples.japanese: {無我|むが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{執着|しゅうちゃく}→執着：05950_shuuchaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}→解放：00135_kaihou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧だ。
examples.english: The teaching of no-self aims at liberation from attachment.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {我|が} (self, ego). In daily Japanese the everyday sense (self-forgetful absorption) is far more common than the Buddhist doctrinal sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無我夢中|むがむちゅう}→無我夢中：05661_mugamuchuu⟧: in a self-forgetful frenzy
- {無我|むが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境地|きょうち}→境地：12121_kyouchi⟧: a state of selflessness
- {無我|むが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to lose oneself (in something)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧: absorbed; engrossed — everyday word for being absorbed in something
- ⟦{無心|むしん}→無心：18803_mushin⟧: free of distractions; innocent — emphasizes a mind clear of thought
- {忘我|ぼうが}: self-forgetfulness; ecstasy — literary; emphasizes losing oneself in emotion
